gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan has large lowercase forms and terminals that stay open, never pinching shut, which makes every line feel spacious. Neon glows above it, every stroke tube-thin and uniform.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gon: Neon glows with a uniform, engraver-cut line, no stroke any deeper than another. And Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi sits beneath it, its terminals cut back to leave wide gaps.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Glowing tubes, bent without any taper. Neon is at its best as a bright, unbroken display line, while Noto Sans Hebrew does its best work with a tall midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ar: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads approachably, its c ending in two points that flare apart like open pincers. Neon is the showpiece for outlines, while this body does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Neon looks like glass tubing bent into letters. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian follows with big open eyes on every e and a, plus a deep middle band, so lines move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Glowing, Neon looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter. Noto Sans Kaithi settles in below with an open e channel and lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals, so a plain sans page flows steadily.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a dark stripe of lowercase through each line, with curves that never close. Neon's tube-like neon-glass stroke adds the glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Neon glass, drawn as a single glowing thread. Noto Sans Khmer feels sturdier beside it, with generous openings and small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Neon draws every stroke at the width of a single stylus, glowing up top, while the body handles the steady reading with rounds left unsealed.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lao: Neon's joins are as thick as its strokes, giving glowing, uninterrupted lines. That makes it the one for display, while Noto Sans Lao handles the reading with a high x-height and mouths that stay open on c, e, and a.
